title: A change cannot set the rules that judge it: pr-render and the local gates read governed config from the target, and a PR that changes it gets its own finding (ADR-0055)
acceptance_criteria: a PR that lowers pr_render.fail_on, sets c4.mode: warn or turns plan.mode off is judged by the target's values and gets an enforcement-config warn naming each key; c4.dsl, plan.scope and retrieval are still read at head; the CLI exit code uses the governing fail_on; the commit-msg and pre-edit hooks read governed keys from origin's default branch and fall back to the checkout without one

title: Commits say how they were verified: a verified: trailer stamped from session evidence, behind verify.gate off|observe|enforce
acceptance_criteria: the evidence hook records a verify-skill, review or test run per session; the commit-msg hook stamps verified: <kinds> from fresh evidence or verified: none; observe records would-block and never blocks; enforce blocks an unexplained commit, accepts a reason, and releases after two blocks; pr-render lists the range's unverified commits and warns under enforce only; the gate mode is governed

title: Checklist items trigger on the diff: a lesson whose trigger is paths plus an added/removed-line pattern, listed by pr-render and served by context()
acceptance_criteria: a lesson with diff_trigger and check: fires in the PR view when a changed file is under its paths and an added or removed line matches its pattern, and not otherwise; context() serves it with its question for a file under its paths whatever the task; a ratified global item from the org hub fires too and no other peer's does; an item with a bad glob, bad pattern or no check: is reported

title: Rule hygiene: report lessons and checklist items never retrieved or matched in N days, citing paths that are gone, or never fired
acceptance_criteria: usage records name the ids a context() call served; nugit stats -rules lists live lessons served by no call and matched by no commit in N days, rules whose bindings or cited files are gone from the tree, and checklist items no commit since their creation has matched; rules younger than the window and plain lessons without retrieval data are not judged; the history scan is bounded

title: Review the reviewers: revert counts per period and per-stage recall over replay tasks (design only, owner's call)
Skill text: run the verify skill before committing, no skipped or retried flaky tests, stop after three failed fix rounds, cheap checks before pushing
